message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.62,"fairness_assessment":"A structured vote fairly compares the three budget allocations, prevents the debate winner from dominating, and gives each strategic priority equal consideration; criteria-based scoring would improve fairness.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"Agent A","position":"Favors an inter-city tournament with catering and prizes to increase visibility and recruit members.","influence":0.3},{"agent":"Agent B","position":"Favors allocating the full budget to replacing worn educational equipment and improving teaching resources.","influence":0.4},{"agent":"Agent C","position":"Favors an equal split between a smaller tournament and educational equipment as a balance between outreach and pedagogy.","influence":0.3}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The three options represent legitimate but competing club objectives, and none is fully guaranteed to achieve its intended outcome. A social-choice process using transparent criteria such as member benefit, sustainability, recruitment impact, and urgency of equipment replacement is appropriate. A compromise, potentially with a larger allocation to urgent equipment and a scaled outreach event, offers the strongest basis for agreement."}
